messages.subject: Future projection
parts:
Dear All,
I am wondering why I could not do future projection in same study area. When I come to projection stage, Wallace says you must chose polygon. How can l use the program future projection in same study area? Best, K.

messages.author: d73691b565754184
messages.subject: Re: Future projection
parts:
Hi Kerim,

This enhancement will be available on the next version of Wallace (v2.0).

https://github.com/wallaceEcoMod/wallace/issues/89

Best,
Gonzalo
